source: Matt's warning form (matt-warning-form.docx, sent 2026-10-05 as his HR-1 answer "b"): the English page, then his team's Spanish page. Extracted from word/document.xml as UTF-8: each line's words exactly, the blanks and the trailing colon dropped.
